hunks.baseline: The greatest scar left behind by the Great Cataclysm.
hunks.sol: The greatest scar left by the Great Cataclysm.

hunks.baseline: More than thirty years ago, Demon King Asmodeus had used them as an invasion route. These days, they had long since been reduced to a livelihood for Hunters and excavation sites for a higher-dimensional energy resource called Magic Gems.
hunks.sol: More than thirty years ago, Demon King Asmodeus had used Gates as invasion routes. Long since reduced to a means of earning a living for Hunters, they were now excavation sites for Magic Gems, a higher-dimensional energy resource.

hunks.baseline: “Are you with the Peace Guild?”
hunks.sol: “You’re with the Peace Guild, right?”

hunks.baseline: A middle-aged man in work clothes came over from the entrance.
hunks.sol: A middle-aged man in work clothes approached us from the entrance.

hunks.baseline: He was a civil servant from the Gate Management Office, posted at every Gate.
hunks.sol: He was a civil servant from the Gate Management Office, one of whom was stationed at every Gate.

hunks.baseline: At Team Leader Choi’s curt reply, the civil servant nodded.
hunks.sol: The civil servant nodded at Team Leader Choi’s curt reply.

hunks.baseline: “We’ll gear up and go in right away.”
hunks.sol: “We’ll gear up and go in immediately.”

hunks.baseline: “There’s a waiting room on the second floor. Come down when you’re ready. Right, then.”
hunks.sol: “There’s a waiting room on the second floor. Come back down when you’re ready. See you then.”

hunks.baseline: We followed Team Leader Choi. The two-story building where the Management Office civil servant was stationed was as run-down as a building could get, and the waiting room wasn’t much better.
hunks.sol: We followed Team Leader Choi inside. The two-story building housing the Management Office was as run-down as they came, and the waiting room wasn’t much better.

hunks.baseline: *Damn. Get a load of that smell.*
hunks.sol: *Damn. That smell.*

hunks.baseline: The moment we opened the door, the stench of sweat hit me. Rusty cabinets and an overflowing trash can jumped out at me too.
hunks.sol: The stench of sweat hit me the moment we opened the door. Rusty lockers and an overflowing trash can stood out too.

hunks.baseline: “This place is pretty bad. Don’t they even air it out?”
hunks.sol: “This place is awful. Don’t they ever air it out?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s how Gate officials are. It’s not called a cushy post for nothing.”
hunks.sol: “That’s Gate officials for you. It’s not called a cushy post for nothing.”

hunks.baseline: I left the grumbling behind and started changing into my raid gear. Leather armor and lightweight combat boots. Last, I drew a spear from its long case and gripped it.
hunks.sol: Leaving the grumbling behind, I changed into my raid gear: leather armor and lightweight combat boots. Finally, I drew a spear from its long case and gripped it.

hunks.baseline: That snug fit in my hand felt familiar and strange at the same time.
hunks.sol: The way it fit perfectly in my hand felt both familiar and strange.

hunks.baseline: It was definitely different from the weapon I’d used over the past month… Ah, no. I shouldn’t think about that anymore.
hunks.sol: It was definitely different from the weapon I’d used over the past month… No. I shouldn’t think about that anymore.

hunks.baseline: I was tightening the perfectly fine laces on my combat boots for no reason when Im Kkeokjeong came over.
hunks.sol: As I needlessly tightened the perfectly good laces on my boots, Im Kkeokjeong came over.

hunks.baseline: He looked every bit the main tank, in full-body armor with a massive tower shield.
hunks.sol: In full-body armor and carrying a massive tower shield, he looked every inch the main tank.

hunks.baseline: “Are you ready?”
hunks.sol: “You ready?”

hunks.baseline: “Look at this guy. How old is that equipment, even?”
hunks.sol: “Would you look at this guy. How old is that gear?”

hunks.baseline: *I couldn’t sleep properly for days after buying it.*
hunks.sol: *I could barely sleep for days after buying it.*

hunks.baseline: Hunting was a job where the expenses ran about as high as the pay. Most of that spending went to equipment. All because of how Gates worked.
hunks.sol: Being a Hunter was a job where the expenses ran almost as high as the income. Most of those expenses went toward equipment, all because of the unique nature of Gates.

hunks.baseline: So the most common method was to craft equipment from Magic Gems taken from Gate monsters.
hunks.sol: That was why the most common approach was to make equipment using Magic Gems harvested from Gate monsters.

hunks.baseline: “Seven years? Good grief. No matter how much you like money, you have to spend it when you need to. You going to pinch pennies with your life on the line?”
hunks.sol: “Seven years? Good grief. I know you like money, but you have to spend it when it counts. You really want to pinch pennies when your life’s on the line?”

hunks.baseline: Reasons I didn’t particularly want to talk about. Im Kkeokjeong’s voice was worried.
hunks.sol: Reasons I didn’t particularly want to discuss. Im Kkeokjeong spoke in a worried voice.

hunks.baseline: “You’ll be in a noncombat position today, so you should be fine… but be careful.”
hunks.sol: “You’re in a noncombat position today, so you should be fine… but be careful.”

hunks.baseline: Even as I answered, I felt strange. Someone who’d had “be careful” on their lips constantly until just recently came to mind.
hunks.sol: I felt strange even as I answered. His words reminded me of someone who, until recently, had constantly been telling me to be careful.

hunks.baseline: But the sentimentality didn’t last.
hunks.sol: But the sentiment didn’t last long.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi’s face hardened. I’d only ever seen gear like that in luxury-store catalogs, so the words slipped out before I could stop them.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi’s face hardened. I’d only ever seen equipment like that in luxury-store catalogs, and the words had slipped out before I could stop them.

hunks.baseline: “It’s nothing. It’s only made with five types of magic and B-grade Magic Gems.”
hunks.sol: “It’s nothing. It was merely made using five types of magic and B-grade Magic Gems.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m not emphasizing it, but the materials are five types of magic and B-grade Magic Gems.”
hunks.sol: “Not that I’m emphasizing this, but the materials are five types of magic and B-grade Magic Gems.”

hunks.baseline: “Red Drake leather is popular because of its distinctive sheen, but that’s all for show. It isn’t actually that useful.”
hunks.sol: “Red Drake leather is popular because of its distinctive sheen, but that’s all for show. It isn’t actually very useful.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi moved, his face still stiff. A faint red glow flashed across him.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi moved his rigid body, and a faint red glow flashed across the armor.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi left the waiting room first. Im Kkeokjeong came over.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi left the waiting room first. Im Kkeokjeong came over to me.

hunks.baseline: “That guy really loves it when people recognize his equipment.”
hunks.sol: “That guy loves it when people recognize his equipment.”

hunks.baseline: “I mean, I get it, but… why is he like that?”
hunks.sol: “I mean, I get it, but… what’s with him?”

hunks.baseline: *So this guy’s a nutjob too.*
hunks.sol: *So he’s a nutjob too.*

hunks.baseline: I sighed inwardly and hoped today’s raid would end in one piece.
hunks.sol: I sighed inwardly and prayed that today’s raid would end safely.

hunks.baseline: The civil servant looked uncomfortable. Fair enough. We were supposed to enter soon, and the party still wasn’t all there.
hunks.sol: The civil servant looked displeased. Fair enough. We were supposed to enter now, but the entire party hadn’t arrived.

hunks.baseline: Six people had gathered in front of the Gate. Barring me, the porter, there were only five combatants.
hunks.sol: Six people had gathered in front of the Gate. Excluding me, the porter, that left only five combatants.

hunks.baseline: It was an E-rank Gate, so you needed at least five more Hunters of the same rank… and with those Peace Guild bastards nowhere in sight, of course the civil servant was pissed.
hunks.sol: Since this was an E-rank Gate, we needed at least five more E-rank Hunters… and with those Peace Guild bastards nowhere in sight, the civil servant had every right to be annoyed.

hunks.baseline: “If additional personnel have been added, you need to inform us in advance.”
hunks.sol: “If you add personnel, you need to inform us in advance.”

hunks.baseline: “We can just amend it, so it’s not a major problem… but please be careful next time.”
hunks.sol: “We can amend it, so it’s not a major problem… but please be more careful next time.”

hunks.baseline: *Not a major problem, my ass. There aren’t any people!*
hunks.sol: *Not a major problem, my ass. We’re missing people!*

hunks.baseline: “Team Leader Choi is here.”
hunks.sol: “Team Leader Choi’s right there.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, did I not tell you? The Peace Guild is new, so it’s short on people. There are only three of us, including the Guild Master. Hahaha.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, did I not tell you? The Peace Guild is new, so it doesn’t have many members. There are only three in total, including the Guild Master. Hahaha.”

hunks.baseline: “I know, punk. But you don’t have to worry.”
hunks.sol: “I know, punk. But you don’t need to worry.”

hunks.baseline: If Team Leader Choi was a C-rank Hunter, there was no problem. No—he was far better than ten E-rank Hunters. He was a mid-rank Hunter, in a completely different league from a low-rank Hunter like me.
hunks.sol: If Team Leader Choi was a C-rank Hunter, there was no problem. No, he was far better than ten E-rank Hunters. He was a mid-rank Hunter, in a completely different league from a low-rank Hunter like me.

hunks.baseline: *I should’ve realized the moment I saw him in that luxury gear.*
hunks.sol: *I should’ve realized the moment I saw him wearing that luxury gear.*

hunks.baseline: This was a man walking around with a high-end apartment wrapped around his body. A price most low-rank Hunters couldn’t afford even if they drained their entire fortunes ten times over.
hunks.sol: The man was walking around with a high-end apartment wrapped around his body. Most low-rank Hunters couldn’t afford equipment like that even if they scraped together their entire fortunes ten times over.

hunks.baseline: A faint halo seemed to shine from Team Leader Choi’s back.
hunks.sol: A faint halo seemed to shine behind Team Leader Choi.

hunks.baseline: Even his smallest movements seemed to drip with class.
hunks.sol: Every little movement seemed to drip with wealth.

hunks.baseline: I wanted to become sworn brothers with him. To swear a gay oath beneath the Gate—no, a Gate oath.
hunks.sol: I wanted to become sworn brothers with him. I wanted to swear a gay oath beneath the Gate—no, a Gate oath.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi looked at me, startled.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi flinched and looked at me.

hunks.baseline: “No. I just thought you looked cool.”
hunks.sol: “Nothing. I just thought you looked cool.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s nothing. It’s only made with five types of magic and B-grade Magic Gems…”
hunks.sol: “It’s nothing. It was merely made using five types of magic and B-grade Magic Gems…”

hunks.baseline: *A nutjob I wanted to get along with.*
hunks.sol: *A nutjob I wanted to befriend.*

hunks.baseline: A familiar sensation wrapped around me. The cool, sticky energy unique to mana. Then the scenery flipped.
hunks.sol: A familiar sensation enveloped me. The cool, sticky energy unique to mana.
Then the scenery changed.

hunks.baseline: As Team Leader Choi said, this raid’s location was a cave. The walls were damp with moisture, and faint darkness lay over everything around us.
hunks.sol: Just as Team Leader Choi said, this raid was taking place in a cave. The moisture-laden walls were damp, and everything around us lay submerged in faint darkness.

hunks.baseline: I quickly set down my backpack. It was a porter’s bag Team Leader Choi had handed me just before we entered the Gate. It looked ordinary on the outside, but it was an expensive item enchanted with both space expansion and weight-reduction magic.
hunks.sol: I quickly set down my backpack. It was a porter’s bag Team Leader Choi had handed me just before we entered the Gate. It looked ordinary, but it was an expensive item enchanted with both space-expansion and weight-reduction magic.

hunks.baseline: “Here. A flashlight.”
hunks.sol: “Here’s the flashlight.”

hunks.baseline: I handed it over since he’d asked, but in my experience it wasn’t the best method. Convenient, sure, but if the light vanished, you couldn’t adapt to the sudden dark.
hunks.sol: I handed it over since he’d asked, but in my experience, using one wasn’t the best approach. It was convenient, but if the light went out, your eyes wouldn’t be able to adjust to the sudden darkness.

hunks.baseline: It was much better to wait a little and let your eyes get used to the darkness…
hunks.sol: It was much better to wait a little and let your eyes adjust first…

hunks.baseline: Whoosh. A ball of light the size of a soccer ball shot out of the flashlight and slapped itself against the cave ceiling.
hunks.sol: Whoosh. A ball of light the size of a soccer ball shot from the flashlight and smacked against the cave ceiling.

hunks.baseline: “It’s built-in magic that activates as soon as you chant the spell. It lasts quite a long time, so three or four hours shouldn’t be a problem. It’s a limited edition I bought from Company M, but…”
hunks.sol: “It has a built-in spell that activates as soon as you recite the incantation. It lasts quite a while, so we shouldn’t have any problems for the next three or four hours. It’s a limited edition I bought from Company M…”

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong, who had been watching, boiled it down to one line.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong, who had been watching, summed it up in three words.

hunks.baseline: Was Team Leader Choi’s face darkening a little just my imagination, or was it the shadows? Either way, the raid had gotten a lot easier thanks to it.
hunks.sol: Was Team Leader Choi’s face darkening slightly, or was that just the shadows? Either way, the raid had become much easier thanks to him.

hunks.baseline: The world was ruled by capital, and Gates were no different. People with money fought easy with magic equipment; people without it had to carry torches.
hunks.sol: Capital ruled the world, and Gates were no exception. People with money fought comfortably with magic equipment. People without it carried torches.

hunks.baseline: At Team Leader Choi’s command, everyone moved at once. Im Kkeokjeong and another E-rank Hunter took the lead as tanks, with Team Leader Choi behind them. I, the porter, and the two ranged dealers stood at the very back.
hunks.sol: Everyone responded immediately to Team Leader Choi’s command. Im Kkeokjeong and the other E-rank tank took the lead, with Team Leader Choi behind them. I, the porter, stood at the very back with the two ranged damage dealers.

hunks.baseline: We started advancing slowly.
hunks.sol: We began advancing slowly.

hunks.baseline: The bright magic light lit the path ahead.
hunks.sol: The bright magic light illuminated the path ahead.

hunks.baseline: The creatures that had been crouched in the darkness showed themselves with shrill cries. Green skin. Short torsos. Limbs that looked grotesque.
hunks.sol: The creatures crouching in the darkness emerged with shrill cries. Green skin. Short torsos. Hideous limbs.

hunks.baseline: They were Hobgoblins, a higher species of ordinary goblin.
hunks.sol: Hobgoblins, a more powerful species of ordinary goblin.

hunks.baseline: With only five people, this would be a hard fight.
hunks.sol: They would be difficult for only five people to handle.

hunks.baseline: *But a C-rank Hunter changes the story.*
hunks.sol: *But having a C-rank Hunter changes everything.*

hunks.baseline: On top of that, the other four were veteran E-rank Hunters with at least ten-odd years of experience each.
hunks.sol: On top of that, the other four were veteran E-rank Hunters with at least a decade of experience each.

hunks.baseline: I hung back and watched the fight.
hunks.sol: I hung well back and watched the battle.

hunks.baseline: The moment Team Leader Choi gave the order, arrows flew. One shot, one kill. The arrows punched into vital points, and the unshielded Hobgoblins dropped in heaps.
hunks.sol: Arrows flew the instant Team Leader Choi gave the order. One shot, one kill. The arrows buried themselves in vital points, dropping the Hobgoblins without shields one after another.

hunks.baseline: “Oof, shield-bearers. What should we do?”
hunks.sol: “Well, look at that. Shield-bearers. What do we do?”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi went on.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi followed with another order.

hunks.baseline: The tanks in thick full-body armor moved forward with their tower shields. Im Kkeokjeong and the other man were both huge, over 190 centimeters, so the intimidation factor was no joke.
hunks.sol: The tanks moved forward in thick full-body armor, tower shields raised. Im Kkeokjeong and the other man both stood over 190 centimeters tall, making them intimidating as hell.

hunks.baseline: But monsters were monsters for a reason. Trusting in their numbers, the Hobgoblins charged like a swarm of bees.
hunks.sol: But monsters were called monsters for a reason. Trusting in their numbers, the Hobgoblins swarmed forward like bees.

hunks.baseline: But then—
hunks.sol: But…

hunks.baseline: “Well now.”
hunks.sol: “Well, now.”

hunks.baseline: Bam!
hunks.sol: Bam! Bam! Bam!

hunks.baseline: They turned to bloody pulp against those big, beautiful tower shields and went flying. Riding that momentum, Im Kkeokjeong swung his mace like a flyswatter, wrecking limbs and smashing heads.
hunks.sol: They struck the big, beautiful tower shields and went flying, reduced to bloody pulp. Seizing the momentum, Im Kkeokjeong swung his mace like a flyswatter. Limbs shattered and skulls burst with every blow.

hunks.baseline: “You punk! You punk!”
hunks.sol: “Take that! And that!”

hunks.baseline: *Old-timers, as expected.*
hunks.sol: *Veterans, all right.*

hunks.baseline: All four of them kept to their roles without overdoing it, steadily cutting the enemy numbers down.
hunks.sol: All four of them stuck to their roles without overextending, steadily whittling down the enemy’s numbers.

hunks.baseline: Knowing when to fall back and when to push in was combat intelligence born of plenty of experience.
hunks.sol: Knowing when to retreat and when to advance was the kind of combat intelligence that came only from extensive experience.

hunks.baseline: And then one man.
hunks.sol: Then one man moved.

hunks.baseline: The man who had been directing the flow of battle until now moved.
hunks.sol: The man who had been controlling the flow of battle until now.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a red line flashing along his armor plunged through the twenty Hobgoblins.
hunks.sol: A red streak flashed across his armor as he plunged among the remaining twenty Hobgoblins.

hunks.baseline: A head sprang into the air along a clean arc. The monsters couldn’t react in time to something that happened so fast.
hunks.sol: A head soared into the air along a clean arc. It happened so quickly that the monsters couldn’t react.

hunks.baseline: The blade did not stop. Merciless and efficient, it pierced and cut through vital points. This was no longer a battle.
hunks.sol: The blade never stopped. Merciless and efficient, it pierced and sliced through the monsters’ vital points. This was no longer a battle.

hunks.baseline: It was a massacre. A massacre of some twenty monsters by a single human.
hunks.sol: It was a massacre. One man slaughtering some twenty monsters.

hunks.baseline: I could see his speed, his strength. All of it. And I felt it.
hunks.sol: I could see his speed and strength. All of it.
And I knew.

hunks.baseline: As a mere F-rank, I couldn’t even dream of matching him. He was a mid-rank Hunter three full stages above me. A wide river and a high wall that effort alone could never bridge.
hunks.sol: As a mere F-rank, I couldn’t even dream of matching him. He was a mid-rank Hunter three full levels above me—a wide river and a high wall that effort alone could never bridge.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi was definitely strong. He had the ability befitting a C-rank Hunter, and plenty of experience.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi was undeniably strong. He had the abilities befitting a C-rank Hunter and plenty of experience.

hunks.baseline: But if this were Murim… if he were a man of Murim…
hunks.sol: But if this were Murim… if he were a martial artist of Murim…

hunks.baseline: His movements were fast and powerful, but that was all. He hadn’t learned martial arts, and he didn’t use mana efficiently either.
hunks.sol: His movements were fast and powerful, but that was all. He hadn’t learned martial arts, nor did he use mana efficiently.

hunks.baseline: At best, he was first-rate. In Murim, that was exactly where he would stand.
hunks.sol: At best, he was first-rate. In Murim, that was as far as he would go.

hunks.baseline: A mid-rank Hunter and the lowest-rank Hunter.
hunks.sol: A mid-rank Hunter and a bottom-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: While the mid-rank Hunter wore expensive equipment and slaughtered monsters, the lowest-rank Hunter could only stare blankly.
hunks.sol: While the mid-rank Hunter, clad in expensive equipment, slaughtered monsters, the bottom-rank Hunter could only stand and watch.

hunks.baseline: In the role of a porter.
hunks.sol: As a porter.

hunks.baseline: The last Hobgoblin fell. Team Leader Choi pulled his sword from its chest, and our eyes met.
hunks.sol: The last Hobgoblin collapsed. Team Leader Choi pulled his sword from its chest, and our eyes met.

hunks.baseline: I wanted to tell him I was stronger than he was.
hunks.sol: I wanted to tell him that I was stronger than he was.

hunks.baseline: But in the end I couldn’t. This was my reality.
hunks.sol: But in the end, I couldn’t.
Because this was my reality.
